subject.title: Feature/Fix: Validate and optimize lineage token accounting

question: Should CodexBar adopt this four-PR lineage subsystem as the supported path for the fork-accounting problem while keeping legacy accounting authoritative until broader promotion evidence exists?
rationale: The implementation is coherent, reversible, well-tested, and proof-positive, but it adds a substantial permanent accounting architecture rather than a narrow mechanical correction; only repository owners can decide whether that maintenance and compatibility boundary belongs in the product.

options.title: Sponsor the staged shadow architecture
options.body: Review and merge https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2155 through https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2158 in order while retaining legacy authority and the promotion gate.

options.title: Narrow to diagnostics only
options.body: Retain the bounded replay and diagnostic tooling but remove or defer the authoritative selector and promotion surface until daily parity improves.

options.title: Pause the lineage stack
options.body: Keep the narrower current-main scanner fixes and close the stack if its maintenance surface is not justified by the remaining accounting error.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the staged shadow architecture
recommendation.body: Review and merge https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2155 through https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2158 in order while retaining legacy authority and the promotion gate.

likelyOwner.reason: They led and merged the current scanner architecture in the same fork, refresh, and cache paths, making them the strongest available routing candidate for the adoption decision.
